name: t1_rdp_bruteforce
label: true_positive
description: Remote desktop password guessing from a single external address: a long burst of failures against one account, then one success, with no attempt to slow down or vary the source.
detectable_as: Failure count per source per account over a short window, followed by a success from the same source.
why_hard: It is not. Any product that misses this is not a detection product. Included as the floor.
